image_description: A male Wood Duck (Aix sponsa) floating on water. The duck features distinctive iridescent green and purple crested head plumage, red eyes with white outlining, a chestnut breast with white speckles, and tan flanks. It is positioned in profile facing left, with its body low in the water and head elevated. The background consists of blurred brownish water and some foreground rocks.
